swap_risks: HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LMV358IDR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=RR vs OPA2333AIDR: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 6.3x (LMV358IDR: 1 V/µs p.7 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.16 V/µs p.7); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).
CAUTION PRECISION OFFSET SHIFT: Maximum Vos differs by 700x (LMV358IDR: 7 mV p.7 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.01 mV p.7); high-gain DC sensor stages may lose accuracy or require zero-drift chopper filtering.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 40% (LMV358IDR: 207.9 °C/W p.6 vs OPA2333AIDR: 124 °C/W p.6); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: LMV358IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) and OPA2333AIDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to rail-to-rail input/output swing differs; slew rate differs >= 3x; input offset voltage Vos differs >= 10x. Key datasheet deltas: device type is opamp (push-pull) vs opamp (push-pull), supply limit is 5.5 V (p.5) vs 5.5 V (p.5), max Vos is 7 mV (p.7) vs 0.01 mV (p.7), input bias current is 15000 pA (p.7) vs 70 pA (p.7), and Iq/ch is 105 µA (p.7) vs 17 µA (p.7). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.4), thermal margin (θJA 207.9 vs 124 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
